items.title: A Jev that can ask Opus for help gives Opus accuracy at 4x lower cost
items.excerpt: We tested whether fast, cheap decision models like Jev and GPT-6 Luna could grade identity resolution as well as frontier LLMs, and found that pairing Jev with Claude Opus gets close to Opus-level accuracy for much less.
